integrity: A self-contained algebraic proof is supplied. A separately coded rational finite-state checker reproduces specified identities through order 11; finite checks are not used as an infinite proof. Independent mathematical assessment has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Assumes known graph order and exact single-vertex return probabilities on a connected unweighted complete multipartite graph; sufficient finite-lag cutoff is not claimed optimal; no statistical stability or sample-complexity bound.
title: One-vertex random-walk returns determine complete multipartite graphs of known order
